# Sotto 0.1.0
First release.
- Hold fn (or Right Command on external keyboards), talk, let go. Clean text lands in the front app. - Everything runs on your Mac. Speech by Parakeet, cleanup by Apple's on-device model. Nothing leaves the machine in Private mode. - Sotto phrases: say "sotto" plus a name to insert a stored block. - Medical vocabulary: core pack plus ten specialty packs. - Learning dictionary, per-app tone rules, "send it", paste last (⌃⌘V), mute music while dictating. - History with stats, audio archive, and Retry.
